metric_definition: Recall@5: fraction of questions with ALL required spans fully contained; MRR@5: reciprocal rank at which ALL required spans are found; not policy-level Recall/MRR. Human review pending.
timing: Sequential models, batch_size=1, no warmup, one call/question; cold start included; combined=embedding+search, excludes scoring/preflight; p95 nearest rank; successful samples persist. Resumes reuse original timings; not a new uninterrupted benchmark.
